description: This file defines a base class 'TransactionTestRunnerBase' used for transaction testing within the Orleans framework. It provides methods to generate and retrieve test grain instances, employing generics and dependency injection.

classes.name: TransactionTestRunnerBase
classes.description: Base class for executing transaction tests, facilitating the creation and management of test grains with support for generics and dependency injection.

methods.name: TransactionTestRunnerBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing grainFactory and testOutput delegate.

methods.name: RandomTestGrain
methods.description: Returns a randomly generated test grain implementing ITransactionTestGrain.

methods.name: RandomTestGrain<TGrainInterface>
methods.description: Generic method returning a test grain of specified interface type with a new GUID.

methods.name: TestGrain
methods.description: Virtual method returning a test grain with a specified class name and ID.

methods.name: TestGrain<TGrainInterface>
methods.description: Generic method retrieving a test grain with a specific class name and GUID.
